#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int B = 1e6;
const int mod1 = 998244353;
const int mod2 = 1e9 + 7;
ll N, counter;
vector<int> vec[10];
int prefixSum[10], result, total;

inline int calc(ll x) {
    return (x % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
}

void dfs1(int depth, ll num) {
    ++counter;
    vec[depth].push_back(calc(counter - num));
    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
        dfs1(depth + 1, num * 10 + digit);
    }
}

void dfs2(int depth, ll num) {
    if (num > N) return;
    if (depth >= 1) {
        if (num * B > N / 10 && (num + 1) * B <= N + 1) {
            int tmp = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i, tmp *= 10) {
                int w = calc(counter - tmp * num);
                int pos = lower_bound(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end(), mod1 - w) - vec[i].begin();
                result = (result + 1LL * w * vec[i].size() + prefixSum[i] - 1LL * mod1 * ((int)vec[i].size() - pos)) % mod2;
            }
            counter += total;
            return;
        }
        ++counter;
        result = (result + calc(counter - num)) % mod2;
    }
    for (int digit = (depth == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit < 10; ++digit) {
        dfs2(depth + 1, num * 10 + digit);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cin >> N;
    dfs1(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
        sort(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end());
        prefixSum[i] = accumulate(vec[i].begin(), vec[i].end(), 0LL) % mod2;
    }
    total = counter;
    counter = 0;
    dfs2(0, 0);
    cout << (result + mod2) % mod2 << '\n';
    return 0;
}
